tier1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW ORIGINAL game sprite, Ashneedle — The Arrow Watchtower, TIER 1 only. This is the beginning of a fresh tower family based ONLY on this written brief; no previous images, towers, concepts or designs are references.
Brief: A fortified archers' perch that rains arrows on approaching foes, quickly cutting down lesser enemies and finishing the wounded. Its identity is the tireless medieval watchman holding the road through disciplined bowfire.
Subject: a narrow, stout square stone watchpost with a simple open timber archers' perch on top. Broad dark front firing opening, chest-high thick wooden protective railing, two sturdy upright timber corner posts, ONE clearly readable resting longbow and compact stocked arrow quiver within the perch. No visible people. Short solid masonry shaft, a small closed iron-bound entry at its foot. Small low crumbly angular stone buildup close to the base, clear entry steps. The architecture is a bowman's lookout, with no cannon, giant crossbow, furnace or flames. Tier 1 is austere and modest, just 3 dominant masses, no roof yet; later upgrades need ample free space above and on both sides.
Canvas: exactly 1024 x 1024 RGBA, genuinely TRANSPARENT background, not a checkerboard painted into the image. Tower perfectly centered at x=512, straight-on front view with only a little top-plane visibility, no sideways three-quarter angle. Entire Tier-1 artwork must fit x=336..688 and y=430..896; actual centered main shaft x=400..624, perch x=356..668. Lowest grounded stone at y=896. Keep the large empty upper and side margins, do NOT enlarge the tower to fill the canvas. No environment, scene, ground tile, drop shadow, labels, frame or text.
Style: simple 2D dark medieval fantasy illustration; strong thick black contours; a few large angular shapes, matte stone and timber, 2-3 broad FLAT color planes per material. Sparse structural seams and very sparse chips, no microtexture, gradients, realistic lighting, glossy 3D, cute cartoon, clutter, glow, magic or particles. Somber, endured, watchful, readable at small size. Dark but legible.
Exact shared 16-color palette, transparency separate; use only these RGB values, material roles fixed across future tiers:
#080A09 ink and deepest openings; #18201D deep stone shadow; #303A34 stone side; #4C554B stone front; #6E7566 stone lit edge; #201D18 timber shadow; #3B3024 timber front; #5B4832 timber lit edge; #806447 bows and arrow shafts; #282D2B iron shadow; #505954 iron face; #889184 iron edge; #B9B294 fletching and Lastwatch accent; #3D2424 cloth shadow; #70423B base muted red cloth; #986C40 Arrowstorm accent.
Tier 1 may use a subset. Reserve #986C40 for a future branch only; #B9B294 only tiny arrow fletching now. Include one small quiet muted red cloth panel on the perch. No flying arrows or transient attacks.
